# Samsung Announces Another Galaxy Event on August 27

 Laurent Giret
 Aug 20, 2026
 0

Samsung announced another Galaxy event on August 27, which will be live-streamed on the company’s YouTube Channel at 8 AM ET. This is coming a little more than a month after the company’s Galaxy Unpacked event on July 22, where the new Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, Fold8, and Flip8 foldable phones were revealed.
results.title: Samsung Announces Another Galaxy Event on August 27

results.content:
Although Samsung just held a huge Galaxy Unpacked event last month, it’s just scheduled a surprise launch for next week.

It’s not another Unpacked, so it won’t be the scale of the July London event, which saw the new Galaxy Z Fold 8 series and new smartwatches unveiled. Instead, Samsung is calling it ‘Galaxy Event August 2026’. [...] It’s fairly easy then to conclude this will be for the Galaxy S26 FE, just slightly ahead of its usual September launch. We were expecting around 4 September to match the Galaxy S25 FE, which would line up with IFA 2026 in Berlin where Samsung annually shows off new devices.
